SessionStart.command: sh -c 'exec 3<&0; if [ -n "${TERM_SERVER_EXECUTABLE:-}" ] && [ -n "${TERM_SERVER_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${TERM_SERVER_BROKER_SOCKET:-}" ]; then sequence=$(date +%s%N 2>/dev/null); "$TERM_SERVER_EXECUTABLE" --agent-event "agy:SessionStart:$sequence" <&3 >/dev/null 2>&1 & else cat <&3 >/dev/null; fi; printf "%s\n" "{}"'
